method: Read each scoped canonical document and corresponding English mirror completely and compare semantic content.
Independently recompute SHA-256 and compare the english-source marker against the current canonical file.
Compare fenced blocks after line-ending normalization, inline literals, and numeric tokens; manually inspect any lexical or human-readable-label differences.
Review translation fidelity to local canonical documents only; do not refresh or independently endorse their scientific/legal/service facts.

notes: Full comparison preserves P01–P11, S01–S05, T01–T04; full-text versus preview/access status; pressure/energy and measured/synthetic distinctions; historical and unexecuted statements; reproduction limitations.

Full comparison preserves CW01–CW07; modal/contact/radiation/air-field distinctions; pressure approximations, numerical-method limits, access failures, unrun experiments, and redistribution limitations.

Full comparison preserves pressure 1/r versus intensity 1/r², dB SPL calibration versus dBFS, finite-surface visibility conditions, path identity, explicit approximation settings, A/R/T conservation, reflected-energy scattering, impedance/phase restrictions, Measured/Derived/Synthetic labels, air-loss domains, retarded geometry, Doppler signs, and V1/V2/V3/V5 boundaries.

Full comparison preserves RIR/BRIR/HRTF ownership, propagation/algorithmic/device delay separation, fractional-delay and FDN stability limits, pressure-versus-energy metrics, independent clocks, historical unimplemented/unrun statements, and the distinction between isolated synthetic kernels and complete V2 validation.

Full comparison preserves contact-normal signs, force/impulse units, normal kinetic loss versus acoustic energy, dynamic/fixed/kinematic distinctions, tuned samples versus measurements, modal/radiation assumptions, bounded audio events, stencil-specific stability, asymptotic cost versus benchmark, rigid Neumann mode oracle, and incomplete fixture coverage.

Full comparison preserves D01–D09 methods, versions, numerical settings, access observations, UNKNOWN terms, code/data license separation, measured versus synthetic sources, SOFA format versus content rights, restricted RIEC use, all NOT RUN states, acquisition pinning/dry-run gates, and V2/V3/V5 evidence limits.

Full comparison preserves current versus historical inventories, conditional adoption versus legal approval, distinct code/binary/data/trademark rights, notices obligations, unknown-license restrictions, synthetic fixtures, and public-distribution gates.
One human-readable inline label is translated: 有條件可採用 → Conditionally adoptable. Technical inline literals are retained.

Raw numeric multiset differs only because source heading 第一版 is rendered V1. Per-line comparison confirmed the additional digit 1 is a faithful ordinal translation; all original numeric values and counts are retained.
Full comparison preserves evidence/authorship categories, phase boundaries, event date uncertainty, immutable history, existing work records, and rights review gates.

The parent corrected RESEARCH-OPS-001. This reviewer reread the complete canonical policy and updated English mirror; pre-event product code owned by the project now preserves ownership without adding a licensing distinction.

Full comparison preserves US$1/three-request authorization, US$0.75 reservations, exhausted request slots, unknown actual billing/credit, live versus fake evidence, the default zero gate, and unaccepted/NOT RUN boundaries.

findings.issue: The canonical wording describes code owned by the project; proprietary can narrow that to closed or restricted-license code, which the canonical sentence does not assert.
findings.required_correction: Replace “pre-event proprietary product code” with “pre-event product code owned by the project”.
findings.resolution: Parent changed the wording to “pre-event product code owned by the project”; independent full reread confirmed fidelity.

limits: This report applies only to the nine pinned source/mirror pairs; it is not semantic proof for all 226 documents.
Source-relative links are pending the parent's coordinated rewrite; link navigation and anchors are outside this review.
Scientific claims, legal rights, billing, account credit, dataset acquisition, runtime behavior, builds, browser/audio/performance, and model/API execution were not newly validated.
Historical, NOT RUN, UNKNOWN, and unimplemented statements were assessed for faithful translation, not promoted to current product facts.
No source or translation edits, Git actions, Wiki mutations, external browsing, builds, API/model/key actions were performed by this reviewer team.
A target or source hash change after this snapshot requires review of the changed content before reusing the result.
